Nifty 50 change around US mid‐term elections, 1990 to 2026.
Price index (dividends excluded), rebased to 0% on the last Indian close on or before US Election
Tuesday, from one calendar month before to three calendar months after.
Orange is 2026 so far, grey is the 1990–2022 median path, and the shaded area spans
all nine past mid‐terms relative to election day (0%).
